errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis (countries) are not listed in alphabetical order. The order starts with EU-27, Malta, Luxembourg, Cyprus, etc., which appears to be roughly descending by the 2008 value for the first several entries.

errors.text_span: за България стойностите са -564.5 през 2008 г. и -593.2 през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the values of -564.5 (2008) and -593.2 (2018) to Bulgaria. According to footnote (1) in the chart, these values belong to Norway.

errors.text_span: а за Исландия стойностите са под -25 за двете години
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Iceland's values are below -25. The chart shows that Iceland's values are positive for both years, approximately 20% and 18%. The country with values far below -25 is Norway.

errors.text_span: Няма явен ред във височината на стълбите между държавите
errors.evidence: This statement contradicts the visual evidence that the first part of the chart is clearly sorted in descending order based on the 2008 values.
